findings.title: Root account does not have MFA enabled
findings.remediation: Sign in as root -> Security credentials -> Assign MFA device (hardware key preferred).

findings.title: S3 bucket ACL grants access to everyone
findings.remediation: aws s3api put-bucket-acl --bucket cloudaudit-seed-public-acl-eval --acl private && aws s3api put-bucket-ownership-controls --bucket cloudaudit-seed-public-acl-eval --ownership-controls Rules=[{ObjectOwnership=BucketOwnerEnforced}]

findings.title: S3 bucket policy allows anonymous access
findings.remediation: Remove statements with Principal "*" (or add restrictive conditions): aws s3api delete-bucket-policy --bucket cloudaudit-seed-public-policy-eval, then enable Block Public Access.

findings.title: No multi-region CloudTrail trail is logging
findings.detail: 1 trail(s) found, none both multi-region and logging
findings.remediation: aws cloudtrail create-trail --name org-trail --s3-bucket-name <log-bucket> --is-multi-region-trail --enable-log-file-validation && aws cloudtrail start-logging --name org-trail

findings.title: Security group allows RDP (3389) from the internet
findings.remediation: Revoke the 0.0.0.0/0 and ::/0 ingress rule on sg-19ff7e068dc36fae2 (us-east-1) with aws ec2 revoke-security-group-ingress; use SSM Session Manager or a bastion/VPN CIDR instead.

findings.remediation: Revoke the 0.0.0.0/0 and ::/0 ingress rule on sg-6db2c01b17cadfed9 (us-east-1) with aws ec2 revoke-security-group-ingress; use SSM Session Manager or a bastion/VPN CIDR instead.

findings.remediation: Revoke the 0.0.0.0/0 and ::/0 ingress rule on sg-01bf673699cc95e7d (us-east-1) with aws ec2 revoke-security-group-ingress; use SSM Session Manager or a bastion/VPN CIDR instead.

findings.title: IAM user with console password has no MFA
findings.detail: Console password set but no MFA device
findings.remediation: Enable MFA for cloudaudit-seed-nomfa-eval (aws iam enable-mfa-device) and enforce it with a policy denying actions when aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent is false.

findings.title: Customer-managed policy grants full '*:*' administrative privileges
findings.remediation: Detach cloudaudit-seed-star-admin-eval from all principals and replace it with least-privilege policies (use IAM Access Analyzer policy generation).

findings.title: Account-level S3 Block Public Access is not fully enabled
findings.detail: Disabled settings: BlockPublicAcls, IgnorePublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy, RestrictPublicBuckets
findings.remediation: aws s3control put-public-access-block --account-id 123456789012 --public-access-block-configuration BlockPublicAcls=true,IgnorePublicAcls=true,BlockPublicPolicy=true,RestrictPublicBuckets=true

findings.title: S3 bucket Block Public Access is not fully enabled
findings.detail: Disabled settings: BlockPublicAcls, IgnorePublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy, RestrictPublicBuckets
findings.remediation: aws s3api put-public-access-block --bucket cloudaudit-seed-public-acl-eval --public-access-block-configuration BlockPublicAcls=true,IgnorePublicAcls=true,BlockPublicPolicy=true,RestrictPublicBuckets=true

findings.title: S3 bucket Block Public Access is not fully enabled
findings.detail: Disabled settings: BlockPublicAcls, IgnorePublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy, RestrictPublicBuckets
findings.remediation: aws s3api put-public-access-block --bucket cloudaudit-seed-public-policy-eval --public-access-block-configuration BlockPublicAcls=true,IgnorePublicAcls=true,BlockPublicPolicy=true,RestrictPublicBuckets=true

findings.title: CloudTrail log file validation is disabled
findings.remediation: aws cloudtrail update-trail --name cloudaudit-seed-trail-eval --enable-log-file-validation

findings.title: Default security group is attached to resources
findings.detail: Default SG attached to 1 network interface(s)
findings.remediation: Move the network interfaces using sg-fd44246ea0e714497 to purpose-built security groups, then remove all inbound and outbound rules from the default group.

findings.title: EBS encryption by default is disabled
findings.detail: New EBS volumes are not encrypted by default
findings.remediation: aws ec2 enable-ebs-encryption-by-default --region us-east-1

findings.title: EBS volume is not encrypted
findings.remediation: Snapshot vol-08dca923f687bd539, copy the snapshot with --encrypted, create a new volume from it and swap it in; enable EBS encryption by default to prevent recurrence.

findings.title: Active access key older than 90 days
findings.remediation: Create a new key for the owner, update consumers, then aws iam update-access-key --status Inactive / delete-access-key for cloudaudit-seed-stalekey-eval/AKIARZPUZDIKFBALWOWS.

findings.title: Account password policy is missing or weak
findings.remediation: aws iam update-account-password-policy --minimum-password-length 14 --password-reuse-prevention 24 --require-symbols --require-numbers --require-uppercase-characters --require-lowercase-characters

findings.title: S3 bucket has no default encryption configured
findings.remediation: aws s3api put-bucket-encryption --bucket cloudaudit-seed-no-encryption-eval --server-side-encryption-configuration '{"Rules":[{"ApplyServerSideEncryptionByDefault":{"SSEAlgorithm":"aws:kms"}}]}'

findings.title: S3 bucket policy does not deny non-HTTPS requests
findings.remediation: Add a Deny statement for all principals on arn:aws:s3:::cloudaudit-seed-no-tls-eval and arn:aws:s3:::cloudaudit-seed-no-tls-eval/* with Condition {"Bool":{"aws:SecureTransport":"false"}}.

findings.title: IAM user has policies attached directly instead of via groups
findings.remediation: Move cloudaudit-seed-direct-eval's permissions to an IAM group (or role), add the user to it, then detach-user-policy / delete-user-policy.

findings.title: S3 bucket versioning is not enabled
findings.remediation: aws s3api put-bucket-versioning --bucket cloudaudit-seed-no-versioning-eval --versioning-configuration Status=Enabled
